changelog:
Initial release of game-design-expert.

- Analyzes a provided game name to generate comprehensive HTML5 game design documents.
- Outputs designs covering core gameplay, special mechanics, visual design, interface elements, technical requirements, and detail optimizations.
- Ensures structured output with no extraneous text, following a strict template.
- Tailors design suggestions for different game genres and platforms, balancing innovation with feasibility.
- Includes example-based documentation to guide users in forming requests and interpreting results.
